title: Fábulas mitológicas del Siglo de Oro
notes: GitHub repository 'arojascastro/fabulasmitologicas': a corpus of mythological fable poems of the Spanish Golden Age (Gongora's Polifemo and Piramo y Tisbe, Lope's Andromeda/Circe/Filomena, Quevedo, Carrillo y Sotomayor, Espinosa...) in TEI XML plus plain text, assembled for stylometric analysis (~150,746 words). Suggested citation 'VV. AA. Fábulas mitológicas del Siglo de Oro. Ed. Antonio Rojas Castro. Barcelona, 2016'. Licence CC BY 4.0 as stated in the README. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
